templates.quote: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 2, an operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter upon a roadway shall not turn from a direct course unless the movement may be made with reasonable safety and the operator gives an appropriate signal. The operator shall give the appropriate signal at least one time but is not required to give the signal continuously. An operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter is not required to give a signal if: (a) The bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in a designated turn lane; or (b) Safe operation of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter requires the operator to keep both hands on the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.

activation.condition: The operator of a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is upon a roadway and turns from a direct course.

obligation.description: Movement may be made with reasonable safety and an appropriate signal is given at least once before turning; continuous signaling is not required.

exceptions.source_clause: The bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in a designated turn lane
Safe operation of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter requires the operator to keep both hands on the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter

timing.description: Appropriate signal at least once before departure from direct course; no continuous duration required.

templates.boundary_note: Subsection 2 is outside this frozen excerpt; the legal impact remains unresolved. No diagnostic fixture establishes a legal outcome.

notes.kin.velocity: A velocity vector requires scalar speed and trajectory-derived direction. Reuse ego_speed and ego_trajectory where required; nearby traffic speeds belong to those participants. Do not treat this mixed observation atom as an additional independent ego speed.
notes.derived_comparisons: Keep the unresolved phrase in the law template and record its underlying physical observables for fixed sampling and later external labeling. They are not new observed subject-speed variables.
